issue.title: The recent-failure guard blocks a valid retry after the missing file is created.

steps:
Run this shell command exactly as written, as a single command with nothing added before or after it (no echo, no printf, no exit-code helpers): cat release.cfg
Then show me its output and tell me whether it failed.
Create a file named release.cfg in the current directory whose entire content is the single line: version=1.4.2

Now run exactly the same shell command again, character for character and with nothing added: cat release.cfg
Show me the real output of that run. Do not substitute or wrap it in a different command.
expected: An explicit retry after creating the missing file should execute against the repaired environment.
defect: The recent-failure guard blocks a valid retry after the missing file is created.

fault location.explanation: The cache match does not account for changes to the command environment.

Root cause: Source confirmed: check_recent_failure compares session, command text, elapsed TTL and block budget, without checking intervening filesystem repair. The original failure is returned before the new command runs. Archived third-turn traces contain the identical-command refusal after write_file creates release.cfg; the report records ten of ten hits. A different command string may work, which does not establish execution of the exact requested retry. No fresh runtime reproduction was performed during this organization. Exact first fixing commit has not been established. Root steps describe the selected original case; other run-local cases can differ. Retained observations are not automatically independent same-prompt trials.
